commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+6' Javi Lopez (Alaves) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+5' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
90+4' Mamadou Sylla (Alaves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+2' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
88' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
88' Luis Rioja (Alaves) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.
87' The substitution has been made. Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) has replaced Darwin Machis.
87' Sergio decides to make a substitution. Roger Marti will be replaced by Jorge Mere (Cadiz).
85' Ander Guevara will be replaced by Mamadou Sylla (Alaves).
85' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
84' A yellow card for bad language! Fali (Cadiz) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
84' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
82' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
79' The ball rebounds to Jon Guridi (Alaves) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
75' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is penalised.
75' Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off his line to gather the ball.
74' Luis Rioja (Alaves) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
73' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
72' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jeremias Ledesma, who smothers the ball.
71' The attendance for today's match is 19306.
71' It will be a substitution. Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) is ready to enter the pitch as Fede San Emeterio walks off.
69' Luis Rioja (Alaves) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
68' The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Javi Lopez (Alaves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
67' Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
65' Substitution. Javi Hernandez makes his way off the pitch and Lucas Pires (Cadiz) comes on as his replacement.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is replacing Ivan Alejo.
64' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Javi Lopez (Alaves) replaces Ruben Duarte.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Antonio Blanco will be replaced by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
64' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Aleksandar Sedlar is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
63' Jon Guridi (Alaves) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
61' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Ruben Duarte (Alaves), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
60' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
60' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

59' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
57' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Miguel de la Fuente and he is replaced by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
56' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
53' The free kick finds Chris Ramos (Cadiz) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just wide of the left post from close range.
52' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
51' Miguel de la Fuente (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.

49' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
49' Cadiz CF are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
48' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
48' Miguel de la Fuente (Alaves) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
48' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
45+4' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45+4' Roger Marti (Cadiz) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Cadiz CF earn a corner.
45+1' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) makes a strong challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
44' Rafa Marin (Alaves) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.
43' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) offside.
43' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' Jeremias Ledesma (Cadiz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' Jeremias Ledesma (Cadiz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

42' Great save! Ruben Duarte (Alaves) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Jeremias Ledesma. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
38' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
38' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
35' Alaves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

35' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
34' Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
31' The referee blows for a cooling break.
31' A bullet header by Chris Ramos (Cadiz) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
30' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) serves up a nice cross, but Antonio Sivera punches the ball away.
29' Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
29' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
28' Roger Marti (Cadiz) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. It will be a corner kick for Cadiz CF.

28' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Antonio Sivera made an astonishing save!

25' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
24' Ander Guevara (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera saw the whole situation. Cadiz CF win a free kick.
21' Ander Guevara (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
19' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
15' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luis Rioja (Alaves).
13' Roger Marti (Cadiz) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
12' A clumsy foul by Ruben Duarte (Alaves) and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle.

10' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Jeremias Ledesma!
10' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jeremias Ledesma intercepts the ball.

7' 1 - 0 GOAL! Javi Hernandez curls the free kick into the box. Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Antonio Sivera and into the right side of the net. 1:0.
6' Rafa Marin (Alaves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Cadiz CF.
4' Roger Marti (Cadiz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
2' The referee blows his whistle as Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' The first half has just begun.
Cadiz CF will kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
